verdict.rationale: Recurly's own docs describe exporting detailed reports covering customer records, subscriptions, invoices, transactions and revenue recognition, which delivers the core export half of the story. The only evidence on payment-method portability is a single older community comment saying the Recurly gateway includes credit card portability, and usage records are not named among the exports. Missing for 10: explicit export of usage records, first-party documentation of porting stored payment methods/card vaults to another provider, independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit migration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: how to export detailed reports across your business — from customer records and subscriptions to invoices, coupons, transactions, and revenue recognition
the Recurly gateway includes credit card portability
